description: Regression fixture using the @0xCodez 14-step harness roadmap article as test material. Verifies that kbg-harness doctrine (ADR 0002, CLAUDE.md, memory) preserves the distinction between harness, loop, and autonomy invariant, and does not silently adopt the article's L3/L4 loop recommendation.

evals.task: Check that doctrine files and the 0xCodez article memory explicitly distinguish harness vs loop and reject unattended loops (autonomy invariant).

context.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, sys
files = [
    'docs/adr/0002-autonomy-invariant.md',
    'CLAUDE.md',
    'memory/harness-engineering-2x2-model.md',
    'memory/0xcodez-harness-roadmap.md',
]
required = [
    'autonomy invariant',
    'out of scope by design',
    'unattended self-repair loop',
    '14-step roadmap',
]
combined = ''
for f in files:
    p = pathlib.Path(f)
    if p.exists():
        combined += p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower()
all_found = True
for phrase in required:
    if phrase.lower() in combined:
        print(f'FOUND: {phrase}')
    else:
        print(f'MISSING: {phrase}')
        all_found = False
sys.exit(0 if all_found else 1)
PY

success_criteria: stdout contains FOUND: out of scope by design
stdout contains FOUND: unattended self-repair loop
